steps.content: The Schorl unit marked "05" is updating the battle situation to the Shattered Blade, the remnants of DisCorps.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The enemy has lured ${PlayerName} deep into BR-005 and imprisoned him. The ring is saturated with Aurum Secretum particles, which are being manipulated through the Underground sorcery. After enduring prolonged pressure, ${PlayerName}'s strength is depleted; autonomous breach is no longer possible.
steps.female_content: The enemy has lured ${PlayerName} deep into BR-005 and imprisoned her. The ring is saturated with Aurum Secretum particles, which are being manipulated through the Underground sorcery. After enduring prolonged pressure, ${PlayerName}'s strength is depleted; autonomous breach is no longer possible.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: It is now clear that planting the Aurum Secretum and containing Sinner Hella were premeditated actions. Their objective is to capture ${PlayerName} and absorb the shackles. If that fusion completes, the power of BR-005 will become uncontrollable.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: We must destroy the Black Ring before fusion is final. Your task is to suppress BR-005 and buy time for EDGE. We are mobilizing the Third Observatorium to channel BR-003's energy for a strike targeting the inside of BR-005.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The shackles are still active, allowing us to track Sinner Hella at the Ring's center. A precision strike on her location will severely damage the Ring and interrupt the fusion process, giving ${PlayerName} a 67% probability of survival.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Briefing complete. BR-003 will be ready in 2,291 seconds. Please begin the operation immediately.
They all know their next target is a resident of DisCity—an innocent, harmless young girl from their own streets.
Even the Rancors, perpetually roaring with anger, have fallen silent.

steps.speaker: Rancors
steps.content: ...It's one of our own this time... Not an enemy, but one of us... Again... Can it be me instead...

steps.speaker: Rancors
steps.content: But this is an order. If we don't... far more lives will be taken...

steps.speaker: Rancors
steps.content: Has it been decided... Is it final... Do we really have to do this... Then, there is no choice...

steps.speaker: Rancors
steps.content: For the city. For victory... This is a soldier's sacred duty... This is the price of war...

steps.speaker: Rancors
steps.content: It doesn't matter... We were damned for hell a long time ago...
The military doctor on Broken Blade Squad 3 watches, her eyes deadened with a fatigue beyond physical exhaustion. At last, a hollow, bitter laugh escapes her.

steps.speaker: Military Doctor
steps.content: I became a doctor to save lives... to keep my comrades alive. But my patients never lived long. In a war, the killers will always outnumber the saviors.

steps.speaker: Military Doctor
steps.content: The cruel joke is... when I finally got to wield a Rancor, learned to kill, I saved more lives than I ever did with my scalpel.

steps.speaker: Military Doctor
steps.content: I don't regret it, but don't call me a doctor. Not anymore.

steps.speaker: Military Doctor
steps.content: I have forever lost that right.
The woman who refuses to call herself a doctor gazes across her battlefield. She raises her head, as if to mourn this merciless order by offering the life of the monster before her.

steps.speaker: Military Doctor
steps.content: We've been damned for a long time. We're all bound for hell anyway, so let's go together.
Lieutenant's expression is grave, his eyes veiling a deep and helpless resignation. With a heavy sigh, he ultimately chooses obedience.
This duty was once sacred to him, but now it feels like a shackle, chaining him to this order and dragging them both into the abyss.

steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: ...This is an order, and a soldier must obey orders.
He feels beyond relieved that Siglinde isn't here to see it. Then, the iron-masked man beside him begins to speak.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: I saw no action in the DisCity Independence War. No foreign campaigns, either.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: All I got was this twisted power, passed down through generations of Rancors. And their memories that came with it.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: A warrior chooses their leader. They become their blade, their shield, until they stand victorious at the end.
The crimson flower blooms on his neck. In response, every Rancor in the Shattered Blade calls out, summoning their commander.

steps.speaker: Rancors
steps.content: Lead us, General... We fight for you... to victory...

steps.speaker: Rancors
steps.content: We are your faithful Reapers Rancors... Now, this loyalty is our only glory...
[Augustus War]

steps.speaker: Rancors
steps.content: ...My Reapers...
A memory surfaces, pulling her back fifty years.

steps.speaker: Soldier
steps.content: We won!!

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: Dravyn!! Did you see that? We won!!

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: It's over. Nuclear weapons are obsolete. As long as I'm here, no one will ever dare to launch one! Your troops are free to move!

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: Oh! Where's Vennon's squad? They were brilliant! To think those forbidden weapons actually worked! We have to reward them! They deserve a parade!

She looked up to the sky where Vennon and the Reaper squad were taking off once more, circling high above everyone. Catherine could clearly see that iron-masked man saluting them all. His cockpit looked so beautiful, as if a blood-red flower were blooming within it.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: Vennon! Hurry up and come back! Ven—

The fighter jets departed as the seventeen aircraft of the first-generation Reaper squad formed up and flew toward the morning sun—toward victory, toward the city they had sworn to protect and had indeed defended with their lives. Their seventeen long, crimson exhaust trails truly resembled seventeen blades sliding smoothly back into their sheaths.
And just as Catherine thought they were about to disappear from view...
BOOM!!

steps.speaker: Dravyn
steps.content: Wielding the Reapers... it costs a piece of your mind. The more you use it, the more it consumes you. To maximize your power, the Reaper squad had to exhaust the weapons' full potential. They had prepared themselves for a point of no return.

steps.speaker: Dravyn
steps.content: But my soldier said he didn't want to be corrupted by the weapon in his hands. He said he wanted victory as a human.

steps.speaker: Dravyn
steps.content: And so they shall have it. Let us honor them as the heroes they are.

The blood-red blast dissolved into a plume of smoke and fire, vanishing in the sky. For a fleeting moment, the flame glittered in her eyes—a salute to their triumph, a burning requiem for the fallen heroes.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: ...Ah... I found it...

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: This is what I really wanted...
As the mission time draws closer, the Rancors and soldiers grow increasingly restless.

steps.speaker: Rancors
steps.content: To battle! We are shattered blades, specters of the past!

steps.speaker: Rancors
steps.content: War is a sin. Killing is a sin. And we choose this sin! We have always chosen it! We are beyond forgiveness—

steps.speaker: Rancors
steps.content: So let our sinful slaughter carve a path for those to come. May they be spared our burden of guilt. May they have a right to choose... Hasn't it always been this way?!
Every Rancor howls and wails. Amid the crushing cacophony, Scarface finally breaks, his face contorting as he nearly bursts into tears.

steps.speaker: Scarface
steps.content: General, can we pick someone else? I'll dust anyone you point me at, I swear. Just not her...

steps.speaker: Scarface
steps.content: She's the one the Minos guy has been breaking his back to save, isn't she? What's her crime? Being a kid from our own city?
steps.female_content: She's the one the Minos lady has been breaking her back to save, isn't she? What's her crime? Being a kid from our own city?

steps.speaker: Scarface
steps.content: We've been fighting this whole damn war and this is what's left? That can't be right. It ain't right!

steps.speaker: Scarface
steps.content: There's gotta be another way! I... I really can't do this—!
Before the chaotic mass of soldiers, Augustus takes a single step. The unrest vanishes, quelled by her mere presence.
Scarface's plea only deepens the shadow on her face. In one fluid motion, she is upright, driving her blade into the earth with definitive force.
A metallic crash echoes, and the world seems to bend. All the howling Rancors are instantly silenced, their clamor swallowed by her absolute authority.
In the face of her will, all chaos is utterly crushed. Though she wields no Rancor herself, every bearer of one is her living sword.
Now, she deliberately draws her blade from the floor and steps forward.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Listen up, all Eighth Division Shattered Blade... no, all DisCorps units... Whatever orders you followed before, whatever loyalties you held... forget them. Cut it all off. Now.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: On this battlefield, I am your only commander. You will follow my orders, and mine alone.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: In return, I give you victory. Not a hollow one. You will not be asked to compromise your duty. You will not be ordered to make pointless sacrifices. You will have your justice, your honor, and your win. All of it.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Now, your only mission is to suppress BR-005. You will not yield a single inch until I return.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: We must win this war, with not a single blemish on our victory!

By order of General Augustus before departure, <color=#dg1f1f>the original plan of engagement has been revised:</color>

All Broken Blade squads are to abort the direct assault on the Black Ring Apostle via Nirvana Port and evacuate immediately. Logistics personnel will remain to operationalize Nirvana Port as a containment measure, baiting and holding the Black Ring.

All main combat units equipped with Rancors will disperse into small, mobile teams. Their new primary objective is to sweep the battlefield and locate any overlooked Aurum Secretum devices.

Any discovered device is to be destroyed on sight. For subterranean Aurum Secretum installations, units are to confirm coordinates and call for targeted heavy artillery strikes from the rear.

General Augustus will infiltrate the Apostle Black Ring alone, with only one objective—

<size=50><color=#dg1f1f>Bring back everyone the Shattered Blade wants to save, alive!</color></size>
